## `neuro.number.toExponential`

Instance method on `Number.prototype`.

> Returns a string containing a number represented in exponential notation.

## Signatures

```ts
toExponential(input: { number: <receiver>; fractionDigits?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Number.prototype.toExponential` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
